name: FantômeRapport
detailed_description:
Story

On the thin line between life and death, your heart wavers.

A ghost ship sailing somewhere in the world.

On the vast sea, you are brought aboard the vessel after nearly drowning.

Here, you meet mysterious women, whose identities are uncertain—are they living or dead?

Amid the enigma of this ghostly luxury liner, as you deepen your connections with the female passengers, an uncertain and shadowy voyage, with no known destination, begins...

About the Game

Fantôme Rapport is a multi-genre visual novel that blends bishojo romance, horror, and mystery. Uncover the secrets of a ghostly luxury cruise liner—and the enigmatic women aboard.

Your choices shape your fate, your companion, and even your past.

As someone with a special bond on this ship, your path is set in motion—toward an ending only you can reach.

See how the story ends—with your own eyes.

Game Overview

This title features a unique dual-structure narrative, combining a suspenseful main storyline with a romantic bishojo segment.

Players will uncover mysteries while also building emotional connections with characters through branching dialogue and heartfelt moments.

Text is available in English and Japanese (some sections may be available in Japanese only).

Characters

Galatea

VA: Rina Kawaguchi

"I am this ship's engineer. I repair the clocks. If something's broken, bring it to me. I'm quite handy. I'll fix anything, not just clocks but the ship too."

With porcelain skin and jewel-like eyes, Galatea is a mysterious young girl who works as a clockmaker aboard the cruise ship.

Resembling an antique doll, she rarely speaks, but her delicate hands reveal her talent as a technician, and she carries a deep well of ancient knowledge.

Manon

VA: Akihiko Suzumoto

"Hey, would you like to come to my room? I'd like to hear your story too. Do you have any confessions?"

With her sweet demeanor and slightly absent-minded air, Manon appears to be a member of the clergy—but she calls herself a “love evangelist.”

After years of devoted service, she's wholly dedicated to caring for others, embodying a true spirit of selflessness.

She enjoys hearing confessions, a habit born from her profession, and though gentle in nature, she tends to go all-in—often to the point of overdoing it.

Ageha

VA: Kaori Maeda

"This ship has all sorts of people...well, not all of them are people... Anyway, there are so many kinds of people here, right? I want to hear stories from all over the world. Let's look around this ship together!"

Though a stranger, Ageha has the warm, easy familiarity of a childhood friend.

Energetic and friendly, she’s a strikingly beautiful girl who claims to be a successful novelist, always on the lookout for inspiration.

She's usually all smiles aboard the ship, but now and then, a fleeting, wistful expression crosses her face. Could it be hinting at something deeper?
